issue_context.title: Update "service using same port but different protocol" e2e to test service reachability
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:
Following are two e2e testing service functioning over same port but different protocol, but do not test service reachability.
1. should be able to update NodePorts with two same port numbers but different protocols
2. should use same NodePort with same port but different protocols
**Note**: _Both the e2e are verifying the same behavior of "service using same port but different protocols"_ differs in `service update` and `service create only`.

**_Primary goal:_** Test service reachability for these E2Es.
**_Secondary goal:_** As both the above e2e are verifying same E2E behavior, it's good to have single e2e in spite of 2 differing in "updating" and "create only" nodePort service.
For "create only", suite has another specific e2e `should be able to create a functioning NodePort service`.

**Why is this needed**:
E2E Improvement and make e2e eligible for Conformance.
Service related e2e are getting promoted in #77865

/area conformance
/sig testing
@kubernetes/cncf-conformance-wg
/assign @mgdevstack
